headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.20
summary: This release fixes the intermittent 32-bit (armeabi-v7a) launch failure from v1.6.1-modder.19, where libminecraftpe.so could fail to open with "library libpairipcore.so not found" even though the library was present: on 32-bit devices every cache dependency of libminecraftpe.so is now loaded explicitly before it, so dependency resolution never depends on directory lookup. The v19 SDK repository itself is proven working on real 32-bit hardware — this release removes the last flaky step between it and the game.

items.text: 32-bit testers: please install the armeabi-v7a APK from this release and launch several times in a row — the failure this fixes was intermittent, so one successful launch is not proof on its own. Your reports (#86, #89, #92, #94, #99) drove every step of this fix chain.

Fixed the intermittent 32-bit (armeabi-v7a) launch failure where libminecraftpe.so failed with "library libpairipcore.so not found" despite the library being present in the same folder (issue #99): on 32-bit devices the launcher now loads every cache dependency of libminecraftpe.so explicitly before it, so its dependencies resolve by soname match instead of the unreliable directory lookup. The v19 SDK repository itself is unchanged and confirmed working on real 32-bit hardware.
